# glad

This directory contains the OpenGL loader generated by
[glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) **0.1.36**.

It is intentionally committed to the repository: it is generated source code,
not a copy of an upstream project, and checking it in keeps the build free of a
Python code-generation step.

Generated with:

    Specification: gl
    API:           gl=3.3
    Profile:       core
    Generator:     c
    Loader:        enabled
    Extensions:    (none)

The generated files can be reproduced either through the
[glad web service](https://glad.dav1d.de/#profile=core&language=c&specification=gl&loader=on&api=gl%3D3.3)
or through the command line:

```bash
pip install 'glad==0.1.36'
python -m glad \
  --profile core \
  --api 'gl=3.3' \
  --generator c \
  --spec gl \
  --out-path vendor/glad
```

Do not edit the files in this directory by hand; regenerate them instead.
